EFW_OlyriaPrime.name: Olyria-Prime
EFW_OlyriaPrime.text: Industrial excavation colony organized around deep field cuts, worker support spaces and survey infrastructure. Visual language: black bedrock, hard industrial geometry, workwear, amber-white practical lights, cool atmospheric distance and strong subject/background separation. Avoid uniform darkness, muddy brown grading or generic mining-world sepia.

EFW_ZenithSpire.name: Zenith Spire
EFW_ZenithSpire.text: Administrative and archival center where institutional authority is expressed through controlled access, sealed records and elevated public spaces. Visual language: ordered pale/cool architectural surfaces, disciplined geometry, restrained interfaces and luminous depth that clearly separates people from background. Avoid generic neon cyberpunk clutter or beige institutional filler.

EFW_VaelTor.name: Vael-Tor
EFW_VaelTor.text: Rainy civilian transit and port city whose current concourses, archives, apartments, utility corridors and landing infrastructure have accumulated directly over much older foundations. Present-day life should feel ordinary, busy and inhabited: wet glass, luggage, vendors, transit signage, maintenance work, balconies, service vehicles and mixed-age construction. Older stone and the buried black dreadnought surface appear as physical layers inside that everyday city, not as a separate fantasy ruin. When the forgotten war becomes visible, preserve residents and refugees as the scale reference; avoid turning Vael-Tor into a generic battle zone, neon megacity or pristine spaceport.
